t: The Magic Rolling Pin: Structuring Websites for AI Navigation
s: Proposes the 'Magic Rolling Pin' concept and 'Rule of 7' to restructure websites and code repositories into navigable hierarchies (max 7 clicks/steps) to overcome 'Deathstar' flat navigation patterns, enabling efficient AI agent traversal and reducing reliance on search engines.
sub: Website navigation structure optimization for AI agents.
The 'Magic Rolling Pin' concept and 'Rule of 7' for balanced hierarchical choices (5-9 options).
Mitigating the 'Deathstar' problem of flat, over-cross-linked web navigation.
Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering for navigational hubs.
AI disintermediation of search engines via direct site navigation.
